name: Yadira Caraveo
summary:
Yadira D. Caraveo ( yə-DEER-ə KAIR-ə-VAY-oh; born December 23, 1980) is an American politician and pediatrician who served as the U.S. representative for Colorado's 8th congressional district from 2023 to 2025. A Democrat, she was Colorado's first Latina member of Congress.
She represented the 31st district in the Colorado House of Representatives from 2019 to 2023.
